description

About the Fund

Blume Ventures Fund IV is the fourth generation of India's leading seed and early-stage venture capital franchise, targeting ₹1,500 Crore in total commitments. The fund focuses on deep tech, climate tech, and B2B SaaS — sectors where India's engineering talent base and domestic market scale are creating globally competitive businesses. As of December 2025, the fund has made 14 initial investments with two at unicorn-scale potential.

Fund IV builds on three prior funds with a combined portfolio of 150+ startups including three unicorns (Unacademy, Dunzo, Slice) and multiple soonicorns. The thesis-driven approach — developing sector investment hypotheses before sourcing — creates proprietary access to the best founding teams before they enter competitive processes. The fund also maintains an evergreen sidecar for follow-on investments in breakout portfolio companies.

Fund Manager Details

person

Sanjay Nath & Karthik Reddy

Managing Partners, Blume Ventures

Combined 45+ years in venture capital and technology entrepreneurship; IIT Delhi / Carnegie Mellon / Wharton and IIT Madras / INSEAD pedigrees

Sanjay Nath and Karthik Reddy co-founded Blume in 2011 after careers in tech entrepreneurship and venture investing in Silicon Valley and India. They lead a team of 12 investment professionals across deep tech, SaaS, climate, and consumer sectors. Both are widely regarded as defining practitioners of India's seed-stage VC ecosystem.
